Subject: Back in Stock: Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket
Preview: It sold out fast last time. Same jacket, ready to ship now.
Body: You already know what wet weather looks like on trail. The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is back in stock — and last time it was gone before most people had a chance to grab one.

Here's what it does: 3-layer laminate construction rated at 20,000mm waterproofing and 20,000 g/m² breathability. That combination means it handles sustained wet weather without trapping heat as you move. It weighs 420 grams. Not a mountaineering suit, not an insulated layer — a shell built for high-output days when the sky doesn't cooperate.

No gimmicks. Just a jacket that does its job in the conditions it was made for.

Stock is limited. If you've been waiting, now's the time.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
